notes:
All signatures verified directly in raw HTML (curl, HTTP 200, desktop UA) from 2 live Gumroad pages on 2026-07-06: zephyrhq.gumroad.com/l/digitalproduct (product, body id=product_page, component Products/Show) and zephyrhq.gumroad.com/ (creator profile, body id=user_page class "group/body custom-domain", component Users/Show). Stack = Ruby on Rails + Inertia.js + Vite + React, fronted by Cloudflare (Server: cloudflare header, rocket-loader.min.js, data-cf-settings present).

EXPORTER TIP: <div id="app"> is empty of rendered DOM; full page content (product name, description_html, covers, seller/profile, price, ratings, refund policy, sections, all SEO meta) is HTML-entity-encoded JSON in the data-page attribute. Parse data-page JSON directly (JSON.parse of decoded attribute) rather than running headless JS. domain_settings in props gives {app_domain: gumroad.com, root_domain: gumroad.com, short_domain: gum.co, discover_domain: gumroad.com, third_party_analytics_domain: gumroad-analytics.com, api_domain: api.gumroad.com} - all confirmed in raw JSON. Inertia component name is in data-page.component.

URL/HOSTING: default storefronts <creator>.gumroad.com; products <creator>.gumroad.com/l/<permalink>; short links gum.co/<slug>. Custom domains supported (profile body carries class "custom-domain") - on a custom domain the URL regex fails; rely on HTML signatures. Drop priority to ~40 when only HTML signatures match on a custom domain.

CDN/ASSETS: assets.gumroad.com CONFIRMED (17 refs on product page: Vite JS/CSS under /vite/assets/entrypoints/, fonts /fonts/ABCFavorit-Regular.woff2, favicon /images/pink-icon.png). public-files.gumroad.com CONFIRMED (6 refs: og:image, twitter:image, second shortcut-icon, user uploads). static-2.gumroad.com appears ONLY as <link rel="dns-prefetch"> - a real Gumroad host but NOT observed actively serving assets on sampled pages; keep as a weak/secondary CDN hint. cable.gumroad.com (ActionCable wss) and api.gumroad.com are also referenced but are not asset CDNs.

BADGE: no server-rendered "Powered by Gumroad" in raw HTML (grep returned nothing) - badgePresent=false confirmed. Any footer attribution is client-side React.

META GENERATOR: none - no <meta name="generator"> found. Confirmed empty.

ANALYTICS: gumroad-analytics.com CONFIRMED as first-party proxy (domain_settings.third_party_analytics_domain). GA/FB Pixel/TikTok Pixel injected client-side only when creator enables them; gr:google_analytics:enabled / gr:fb_pixel:enabled / gr:tiktok_pixel:enabled were all "true" on the sampled product page. analytics.tiktok.com and the facebook/googletagmanager hosts appear in the page CSP allow-list. Stripe publishable key exposed via <meta property="stripe:pk" value="pk_live_..."> - confirmed.

ANTI-BOT: Cloudflare confirmed; desktop UA got HTTP 200 with no JS challenge on both product and profile pages. Retry logic still recommended (researcher noted intermittent 502s on some homepages).
